2026.05-2026.09.reason:
Accepted. Every breach traces to a documented upstream reorganization in dr5hn v3.2, and each removes rows that were miscategorised rather than losing real places. Verified by sampling the removed rows per country:

cities/US (3,104): US counties ("Autauga County", "Baldwin County") that upstream moved out of the cities table via relocate_us_counties.py. A county is not a city.
cities/TH (645): "Amphoe X" entries -- amphoe is a district, not a settlement.
cities/TR (510): "X Ilcesi" district entries plus province names (Adiyaman, Afyonkarahisar) that duplicate state-level rows.
cities/ID (424): "Kabupaten X" regency entries -- an administrative division, not a city.
cities/PL (315): "Powiat X" county entries.
cities/RO (107): "Comuna X" / "Oras X" administrative units.
cities/PH (123): residual duplicates after upstream deduplication; the bulk of the earlier PH delta was matcher noise, not removal.

states (432): genuine administrative reforms upstream implemented -- North Macedonia municipality restructure (83), Latvia's 2021 municipal reform (78), Albania's county/district reorganisation (34), Vietnam's province mergers (29), Greece's Kallikratis regional units (25).

Net effect is +495 states and +2,261 cities. No populated place known to the old snapshot disappears without a documented reason.
